adjust_learning_rate_cosine_warmup: adjust the learning rate of an optimizer using a half-cycle cosine schedule with linear warmup
create_optimizer_lr_schedule: create a learning rate schedule that warms up linearly then decays with cosine annealing
build_training_lr_scheduler: build a training loop that adjusts optimizer learning rate each epoch with warmup and cosine decay
refactor_lr_schedule_with_scaling: refactor the learning rate schedule to support per-param-group lr_scale multipliers
review_cosine_decay_formula: review the cosine decay formula that computes learning rate between min_lr and lr after warmup epochs
